timeline: You think medieval guards relied on bells for warning, but at Golconda Fort in 1518, they used their bare hands.
People often think it was magic.
Or perhaps secret underground speaking tubes carved in stone.
But the real answer is pure medieval acoustic engineering.
A single hand clap beneath the dome at Fateh Darwaza travels one kilometer.
Reverberating clearly all the way up to the Bala Hisar pavilion.
An ingenious ancient alarm system that saved a kingdom.
How did a hand clap at the outer gate of Golconda Fort serve as an intruder alarm to the hilltop citadel in 1518?
